sentences.chapter: Rafale on INS Vikrant without a catapult
sentences.text: The twenty-ninth of October.

sentences.chapter: Rafale on INS Vikrant without a catapult
sentences.text: A Rafale fighter, here for trials, comes down on India's newest aircraft carrier, I-N-S Vikrant.

sentences.chapter: Rafale on INS Vikrant without a catapult
sentences.text: This deck is missing something that India's first carrier had, back in nineteen sixty-one.

sentences.chapter: Rafale on INS Vikrant without a catapult
sentences.text: A catapult.

sentences.chapter: Rafale on INS Vikrant without a catapult
sentences.text: The Rafale was built to be thrown off a ship by one.

sentences.chapter: Rafale on INS Vikrant without a catapult
sentences.text: Vikrant has a ramp instead.

sentences.chapter: Rafale on INS Vikrant without a catapult
sentences.text: The jet can leave by that ramp.

sentences.chapter: Rafale on INS Vikrant without a catapult
sentences.text: It passed that test in Goa.

sentences.chapter: Rafale on INS Vikrant without a catapult
sentences.text: But think about this.

sentences.chapter: Rafale on INS Vikrant without a catapult
sentences.text: Sixty-five years ago, India was throwing jets off a ship.

sentences.chapter: Rafale on INS Vikrant without a catapult
sentences.text: Today the Navy wants a catapult again — and the one India is building so far, is a small test model.

sentences.chapter: Rafale on INS Vikrant without a catapult
sentences.text: So what happened in between?

sentences.chapter: Rafale on INS Vikrant without a catapult
sentences.text: And here is something you would not guess.

sentences.chapter: Rafale on INS Vikrant without a catapult
sentences.text: The electricity to throw a fighter jet costs you less than two hundred rupees.

sentences.chapter: Rafale on INS Vikrant without a catapult
sentences.text: Yet it is one of the hardest machines on earth.

sentences.chapter: Rafale on INS Vikrant without a catapult
sentences.text: By the end of this film, you will see why.

sentences.chapter: Why INS Vikrant has a ski-jump ramp
sentences.text: Come and stand on Vikrant's deck with me.

sentences.chapter: Why INS Vikrant has a ski-jump ramp
sentences.text: In front of you, the deck curves upward, like a flyover that ends in the sky.

sentences.chapter: Why INS Vikrant has a ski-jump ramp
sentences.text: Do you see any moving parts on that ramp?

sentences.chapter: Why INS Vikrant has a ski-jump ramp
sentences.text: None.

sentences.chapter: Why INS Vikrant has a ski-jump ramp
sentences.text: The jet opens its engines fully, runs, and the curve throws it up.

sentences.chapter: Why INS Vikrant has a ski-jump ramp
sentences.text: Nothing you can break.

sentences.chapter: Why INS Vikrant has a ski-jump ramp
sentences.text: Nothing you must repair.

sentences.chapter: Why INS Vikrant has a ski-jump ramp
sentences.text: You have to admit, it is a clever idea.

sentences.chapter: Why INS Vikrant has a ski-jump ramp
sentences.text: But here's the catch.

sentences.chapter: Why INS Vikrant has a ski-jump ramp
sentences.text: On a ramp, the jet must lift itself, with its own engines.

sentences.chapter: Why INS Vikrant has a ski-jump ramp
sentences.text: So you take off lighter.

sentences.chapter: Why INS Vikrant has a ski-jump ramp
sentences.text: You carry less fuel, or fewer weapons, or both.

sentences.chapter: Why INS Vikrant has a ski-jump ramp
sentences.text: How much lighter?

sentences.chapter: Why INS Vikrant has a ski-jump ramp
sentences.text: The Navy has not published that number.

sentences.chapter: Why INS Vikrant has a ski-jump ramp
sentences.text: So I won't invent one for you.

sentences.chapter: Why INS Vikrant has a ski-jump ramp
sentences.text: What nobody argues about is this.

sentences.chapter: Why INS Vikrant has a ski-jump ramp
sentences.text: You cannot get a heavy, slow aircraft off a ramp at all.

sentences.chapter: Why INS Vikrant has a ski-jump ramp
sentences.text: And which heavy aircraft matters most at sea?

sentences.chapter: Why INS Vikrant has a ski-jump ramp
sentences.text: The flying radar.

sentences.chapter: Why INS Vikrant has a ski-jump ramp
sentences.text: A plane with a big dish on its back, that sees trouble long before your ship can.

sentences.chapter: Why INS Vikrant has a ski-jump ramp
sentences.text: India's carriers do that job with a helicopter.

sentences.chapter: Why INS Vikrant has a ski-jump ramp
sentences.text: It works.

sentences.chapter: Why INS Vikrant has a ski-jump ramp
sentences.text: But ask naval experts, and they will tell you, a helicopter cannot do it as well as a plane.

sentences.chapter: Why INS Vikrant has a ski-jump ramp
sentences.text: So the ramp has a price.

sentences.chapter: Why INS Vikrant has a ski-jump ramp
sentences.text: Then why did India choose it?

sentences.chapter: Why INS Vikrant has a ski-jump ramp
sentences.text: To answer that, you must first see the catapult we already had, and how we let it go.

sentences.chapter: India's 1961 steam catapult and the 1971 war
sentences.text: Belfast, the fourth of March, nineteen sixty-one.

sentences.chapter: India's 1961 steam catapult and the 1971 war
sentences.text: India commissions its first aircraft carrier, bought from Britain and finished in that shipyard.

sentences.chapter: India's 1961 steam catapult and the 1971 war
sentences.text: Her name, too, is Vikrant.

sentences.chapter: India's 1961 steam catapult and the 1971 war
sentences.text: And under her deck is a steam catapult.

sentences.chapter: India's 1961 steam catapult and the 1971 war
sentences.text: How does steam throw a jet?

sentences.chapter: India's 1961 steam catapult and the 1971 war
sentences.text: You already own a small one.

sentences.chapter: India's 1961 steam catapult and the 1971 war
sentences.text: The pressure cooker in your kitchen.

sentences.chapter: India's 1961 steam catapult and the 1971 war
sentences.text: Steam builds up behind the weight, and when it goes, it goes with force.

sentences.chapter: India's 1961 steam catapult and the 1971 war
sentences.text: On the ship, that steam drives a piston along a tube under the deck, and the piston drags the jet.

sentences.chapter: India's 1961 steam catapult and the 1971 war
sentences.text: For nine years, it works.

sentences.chapter: India's 1961 steam catapult and the 1971 war
sentences.text: Then, in June nineteen seventy, in Bombay, the engineers find cracks in a boiler.

sentences.chapter: India's 1961 steam catapult and the 1971 war
sentences.text: Not one crack.

sentences.chapter: India's 1961 steam catapult and the 1971 war
sentences.text: Many, in the drums that hold the water.

sentences.chapter: India's 1961 steam catapult and the 1971 war
sentences.text: You cannot weld them.

sentences.chapter: India's 1961 steam catapult and the 1971 war
sentences.text: And a lasting repair is not possible in India.

sentences.chapter: India's 1961 steam catapult and the 1971 war
sentences.text: Do you see what that means?

sentences.chapter: India's 1961 steam catapult and the 1971 war
sentences.text: The same steam that turns the propellers, also fires the catapult.

sentences.chapter: India's 1961 steam catapult and the 1971 war
sentences.text: If you push those boilers too hard, in the words of Admiral Arun Prakash, they could simply blow up.

sentences.chapter: India's 1961 steam catapult and the 1971 war
sentences.text: Would you send that ship to war?

sentences.chapter: India's 1961 steam catapult and the 1971 war
sentences.text: So the ship is held to fourteen knots.

sentences.chapter: India's 1961 steam catapult and the 1971 war
sentences.text: That is about twenty-six kilometres an hour.

sentences.chapter: India's 1961 steam catapult and the 1971 war
sentences.text: Too slow for a carrier.

sentences.chapter: India's 1961 steam catapult and the 1971 war
sentences.text: And some very senior officers say, leave her out of the next war.

sentences.chapter: India's 1961 steam catapult and the 1971 war
sentences.text: The Navy chief, Admiral Nanda, will not have it.

sentences.chapter: India's 1961 steam catapult and the 1971 war
sentences.text: If Vikrant sits out a war, he says, she will be called a white elephant, and naval flying will be written off.

sentences.chapter: India's 1961 steam catapult and the 1971 war
sentences.text: So it comes down to the engine room, and to one man.

sentences.chapter: India's 1961 steam catapult and the 1971 war
sentences.text: Commander Benoy Roy Chowdhury, the ship's engineer.

sentences.chapter: India's 1961 steam catapult and the 1971 war
sentences.text: His shipmates call him Beeloo.

sentences.chapter: India's 1961 steam catapult and the 1971 war
sentences.text: What would you do with a cracked boiler, and no spare?

sentences.chapter: India's 1961 steam catapult and the 1971 war
sentences.text: Beeloo and his team put steel bands around it.

sentences.chapter: India's 1961 steam catapult and the 1971 war
sentences.text: They reset the safety valves, to accept more risk.

sentences.chapter: India's 1961 steam catapult and the 1971 war
sentences.text: And they keep the boiler room almost empty.

sentences.chapter: India's 1961 steam catapult and the 1971 war
sentences.text: Because if a drum bursts, that room fills with superheated steam.

sentences.chapter: India's 1961 steam catapult and the 1971 war
sentences.text: It holds.

sentences.chapter: India's 1961 steam catapult and the 1971 war
sentences.text: On the fourth of December, nineteen seventy-one, Sea Hawk jets leave Vikrant's catapult, and strike Cox's Bazar.

sentences.chapter: India's 1961 steam catapult and the 1971 war
sentences.text: And for his work in that boiler room, Beeloo is given the Vir Chakra, a medal for bravery.

sentences.chapter: India's 1961 steam catapult and the 1971 war
sentences.text: So India did not only have a catapult.

sentences.chapter: India's 1961 steam catapult and the 1971 war
sentences.text: India kept one alive with steel bands, and took it to war.

sentences.chapter: India's 1961 steam catapult and the 1971 war
sentences.text: Then how did we lose it?

sentences.chapter: India's 1961 steam catapult and the 1971 war
sentences.text: In the nineteen eighties, the Navy bought the Sea Harrier, a jet that needs no catapult.

sentences.chapter: India's 1961 steam catapult and the 1971 war
sentences.text: The last planes that still needed the catapult, the old propeller planes, retired in nineteen eighty-nine.

sentences.chapter: India's 1961 steam catapult and the 1971 war
sentences.text: So the catapult came out, and a ramp went on.

sentences.chapter: India's 1961 steam catapult and the 1971 war
sentences.text: You can see why.

sentences.chapter: India's 1961 steam catapult and the 1971 war
sentences.text: It made sense then.

sentences.chapter: India's 1961 steam catapult and the 1971 war
sentences.text: And when India designed its own carrier, the new Vikrant, she was drawn around a ramp jet too.

sentences.chapter: India's 1961 steam catapult and the 1971 war
sentences.text: Her engines are gas turbines.

sentences.chapter: India's 1961 steam catapult and the 1971 war
sentences.text: They make no steam for a catapult.

sentences.chapter: India's 1961 steam catapult and the 1971 war
sentences.text: And naval analysts say there is no room under that ramp to add one now.

sentences.chapter: India's 1961 steam catapult and the 1971 war
sentences.text: So steam is gone.

sentences.chapter: India's 1961 steam catapult and the 1971 war
sentences.text: If you want to throw a jet again, you have to do it with electricity.

sentences.chapter: How an electric catapult (EMALS) works
sentences.text: Look up at your ceiling fan.

sentences.chapter: How an electric catapult (EMALS) works
sentences.text: Do you know what turns it?

sentences.chapter: How an electric catapult (EMALS) works
sentences.text: An induction motor.

sentences.chapter: How an electric catapult (EMALS) works
sentences.text: Coils of wire in a circle, and a magnetic pull that chases round and round.

sentences.chapter: How an electric catapult (EMALS) works
sentences.text: Now cut that circle in your mind, and unroll it flat.

sentences.chapter: How an electric catapult (EMALS) works
sentences.text: You get a straight line of coils, about a hundred metres long, laid under the deck.

sentences.chapter: How an electric catapult (EMALS) works
sentences.text: The pull no longer goes round.

sentences.chapter: How an electric catapult (EMALS) works
sentences.text: It runs straight ahead, and it takes the jet with it.

sentences.chapter: How an electric catapult (EMALS) works
sentences.text: Only the coils beside the jet are switched on.

sentences.chapter: How an electric catapult (EMALS) works
sentences.text: A wave of force, racing down the deck.

sentences.chapter: How an electric catapult (EMALS) works
sentences.text: Now count with me.

sentences.chapter: How an electric catapult (EMALS) works
sentences.text: One.

sentences.chapter: How an electric catapult (EMALS) works
sentences.text: Two.

sentences.chapter: How an electric catapult (EMALS) works
sentences.text: Three.

sentences.chapter: How an electric catapult (EMALS) works
sentences.text: By the time you finish counting, a thirty-tonne fighter has gone from standing still, to two hundred and forty kilometres an hour.

sentences.chapter: How an electric catapult (EMALS) works
sentences.text: And what does that take, in electricity?

sentences.chapter: How an electric catapult (EMALS) works
sentences.text: Here is the number I promised you.

sentences.chapter: How an electric catapult (EMALS) works
sentences.text: The energy in that moving jet is about nineteen units of electricity.

sentences.chapter: How an electric catapult (EMALS) works
sentences.text: An average Indian home uses that much in about six days.

sentences.chapter: How an electric catapult (EMALS) works
sentences.text: On your bill, it is well under two hundred rupees.

sentences.chapter: How an electric catapult (EMALS) works
sentences.text: Then where is the difficulty?

sentences.chapter: How an electric catapult (EMALS) works
sentences.text: In the three seconds.

sentences.chapter: How an electric catapult (EMALS) works
sentences.text: Your home sips that energy over six days.

sentences.chapter: How an electric catapult (EMALS) works
sentences.text: The catapult must pour it out in three seconds.

sentences.chapter: How an electric catapult (EMALS) works
sentences.text: At its peak, that is close to fifty megawatts.

sentences.chapter: How an electric catapult (EMALS) works
sentences.text: More than half of what all four of Vikrant's engines make together.

sentences.chapter: How an electric catapult (EMALS) works
sentences.text: Can you take that from a ship's engines, in an instant?

sentences.chapter: How an electric catapult (EMALS) works
sentences.text: No.

sentences.chapter: How an electric catapult (EMALS) works
sentences.text: So you save up.

sentences.chapter: How an electric catapult (EMALS) works
sentences.text: Between launches, you spin up great steel machines, each one over thirty-six tonnes, like giant spinning tops.

sentences.chapter: How an electric catapult (EMALS) works
sentences.text: Then you pull the energy back out of that spin, and that becomes the push.

sentences.chapter: How an electric catapult (EMALS) works
sentences.text: And you must do this again every forty-five seconds, for years, on a ship at sea.

sentences.chapter: How an electric catapult (EMALS) works
sentences.text: So now you know the real machine.

sentences.chapter: How an electric catapult (EMALS) works
sentences.text: Not a motor.

sentences.chapter: How an electric catapult (EMALS) works
sentences.text: A power station, that works for three seconds at a time.

sentences.chapter: China's Fujian vs America's USS Ford
sentences.text: Has anyone made it work?

sentences.chapter: China's Fujian vs America's USS Ford
sentences.text: Two navies have.

sentences.chapter: China's Fujian vs America's USS Ford
sentences.text: And their stories run in opposite directions.

sentences.chapter: China's Fujian vs America's USS Ford
sentences.text: Let's start with China.

sentences.chapter: China's Fujian vs America's USS Ford
sentences.text: China never sent a steam catapult to sea.

sentences.chapter: China's Fujian vs America's USS Ford
sentences.text: From twenty sixteen, it was throwing a test jet from catapults built on land.

sentences.chapter: China's Fujian vs America's USS Ford
sentences.text: Nine years later, in November twenty twenty-five, it commissioned the carrier Fujian, with electric catapults.

sentences.chapter: China's Fujian vs America's USS Ford
sentences.text: Fujian has already thrown a flying radar plane into the air.

sentences.chapter: China's Fujian vs America's USS Ford
sentences.text: And she is not nuclear powered.

sentences.chapter: China's Fujian vs America's USS Ford
sentences.text: So you do not need a reactor for this machine.

sentences.chapter: China's Fujian vs America's USS Ford
sentences.text: You need stored power.

sentences.chapter: China's Fujian vs America's USS Ford
sentences.text: And America, which invented it?

sentences.chapter: China's Fujian vs America's USS Ford
sentences.text: Its first ship with electric catapults is the U-S-S Ford.

sentences.chapter: China's Fujian vs America's USS Ford
sentences.text: The American Navy wanted more than four thousand launches between serious failures.

sentences.chapter: China's Fujian vs America's USS Ford
sentences.text: In twenty twenty, the testers measured one hundred and eighty-one.

sentences.chapter: China's Fujian vs America's USS Ford
sentences.text: In twenty twenty-two, six hundred and fourteen.

sentences.chapter: China's Fujian vs America's USS Ford
sentences.text: Far short.

sentences.chapter: China's Fujian vs America's USS Ford
sentences.text: But the ship did not stop flying.

sentences.chapter: China's Fujian vs America's USS Ford
sentences.text: By the programme's own count, the Ford has made more than thirty-six thousand launches.

sentences.chapter: China's Fujian vs America's USS Ford
sentences.text: Steam catapults had many decades to mature.

sentences.chapter: China's Fujian vs America's USS Ford
sentences.text: This one is still young.

sentences.chapter: China's Fujian vs America's USS Ford
sentences.text: Even so, this August, the American President ordered a plan to go back to steam on a future carrier.

sentences.chapter: China's Fujian vs America's USS Ford
sentences.text: The company that builds the electric one has asked the government to think again.

sentences.chapter: China's Fujian vs America's USS Ford
sentences.text: As this film is made, nothing final has been announced.

sentences.chapter: China's Fujian vs America's USS Ford
sentences.text: So the inventor is in two minds, and the newcomer is already flying.

sentences.chapter: China's Fujian vs America's USS Ford
sentences.text: Where does that leave India?

sentences.chapter: DRDO's electric catapult demonstrator
sentences.text: In Pune, in Maharashtra, engineers at a D-R-D-O laboratory are building India's own electric catapult.

sentences.chapter: DRDO's electric catapult demonstrator
sentences.text: Remember that small test model?

sentences.chapter: DRDO's electric catapult demonstrator
sentences.text: This is it.

sentences.chapter: DRDO's electric catapult demonstrator
sentences.text: As reported, it is meant to throw up to four hundred kilos, over about seventeen metres.

sentences.chapter: DRDO's electric catapult demonstrator
sentences.text: I say as reported, because D-R-D-O itself has published very little about it.

sentences.chapter: DRDO's electric catapult demonstrator
sentences.text: Now put the Navy's need beside it, and you see the gap.

sentences.chapter: DRDO's electric catapult demonstrator
sentences.text: Not four hundred kilos.

sentences.chapter: DRDO's electric catapult demonstrator
sentences.text: Thirty tonnes.

sentences.chapter: DRDO's electric catapult demonstrator
sentences.text: Not seventeen metres.

sentences.chapter: DRDO's electric catapult demonstrator
sentences.text: About a hundred.

sentences.chapter: DRDO's electric catapult demonstrator
sentences.text: That is seventy-five times the weight.

sentences.chapter: DRDO's electric catapult demonstrator
sentences.text: A full-size one, say officials quoted in the defence press, is a decade or more away.

sentences.chapter: DRDO's electric catapult demonstrator
sentences.text: You might ask me, Kishore, who is stopping India from building its own?

sentences.chapter: DRDO's electric catapult demonstrator
sentences.text: Nobody.

sentences.chapter: DRDO's electric catapult demonstrator
sentences.text: Nobody is stopping us.

sentences.chapter: DRDO's electric catapult demonstrator
sentences.text: But look at what China had, that India does not have yet.

sentences.chapter: DRDO's electric catapult demonstrator
sentences.text: A full-size test track on land.

sentences.chapter: DRDO's electric catapult demonstrator
sentences.text: And a ship waiting for the machine.

sentences.chapter: DRDO's electric catapult demonstrator
sentences.text: The Navy's own fifteen-year plan asks for two electric catapults.

sentences.chapter: DRDO's electric catapult demonstrator
sentences.text: But the next carrier close to approval, at an estimated forty thousand crore rupees, is a repeat of Vikrant.

sentences.chapter: DRDO's electric catapult demonstrator
sentences.text: With a ramp.

sentences.text: Then why not just buy one?

sentences.chapter: DRDO's electric catapult demonstrator
sentences.text: You may remember the reports in twenty seventeen, that America was ready to sell it to India.

sentences.text: Nothing was signed.

sentences.chapter: DRDO's electric catapult demonstrator
sentences.text: Later, America cleared the same system for France.

sentences.chapter: DRDO's electric catapult demonstrator
sentences.text: The estimate for one ship's set, with the wires that stop a landing jet, was one point three billion dollars.

sentences.chapter: DRDO's electric catapult demonstrator
sentences.text: Around eleven thousand crore rupees, before you build the ship.

sentences.chapter: DRDO's electric catapult demonstrator
sentences.text: So let me put it to you plainly.

sentences.chapter: DRDO's electric catapult demonstrator
sentences.text: The jets are ordered.

sentences.chapter: DRDO's electric catapult demonstrator
sentences.text: Twenty-six Rafales, for about sixty-three thousand crore rupees.

sentences.chapter: DRDO's electric catapult demonstrator
sentences.text: The catapult is a small test model.

sentences.text: And the ship is not approved.

sentences.chapter: DRDO's electric catapult demonstrator
sentences.text: Until that changes, India's Rafales will fly from ramps.
